title: Order the Machines
story: Two machines are built from one another. Put them in a working order.
goal: Put the lines in order so the program prints 27.
hints: A function must be defined before the line that calls it runs.
square comes before cube because cube uses it. The print comes last.
socratic: What must exist before a call?
Why does cube need square defined first?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what decides the order of these lines?
